A.label: Day A — Strength
A.warmup: 5 min: Hip hinge prying (bodyweight squat prying knees apart), halos 5 each side

blocks.name: Turkish Get-Up
blocks.note: Deliberate. 60–90 sec per rep. This is practice, not conditioning.

blocks.name: Clean & Press — Ladder
blocks.note: One rung: 1L press, 1R press, rest. 2L, 2R, rest. 3L, 3R, rest. That's one ladder. Rest 60–90 sec between rungs.

blocks.name: Goblet Squat
blocks.note: Deep, controlled descent. Pause at bottom. Elbows inside knees.

blocks.name: Bent-Over Row
blocks.note: Brace like you're about to take a punch. Pull the elbow back, not up.

B.label: Day B — Power
B.warmup: 3 min: Deadlift practice from the floor, hip hinge groove

blocks.name: Two-Hand Swing — EMOM
blocks.note: Start the clock. 10 hard swings. Rest what remains of the minute. The hinge is everything — not a squat, not a back exercise.

blocks.name: One-Hand Swing
blocks.note: Same hip snap. Let the bell arc naturally. Don't muscle it up.

blocks.name: Snatch
blocks.note: Week 1: omit. Week 2: 3×3 each side. Week 3+: 3×5 each side. Punch through at the top — don't flip the bell over the wrist.

B.saturdayNote: Saturday: half volume — 5×10 swings EMOM, 2 TGU each side, no snatch. Active recovery.
